ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with a white-to-black pixel ratio estimated at less than 0.05:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes. Sparse, high-contrast white punctate blobs are visible as discrete clusters on the distal half of the right lobe and scattered along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with a sharp convergence; deep penetration into the fluke body relative to the horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations. Notable deep indentations and sharp, jagged peaks are continuous across the posterior boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe exhibits a predominantly concave upward sweep from the notch to the tip, while the right lobe shows a more pronounced convex curve on its outer distal edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, high-intensity white pixel clusters (approx. 2-5 pixels in diameter) scattered across the mid-region of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss (major U-shaped notch) on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip. Distinct irregular thickening or encrustation is visible on the tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge exhibits an extreme degree of serration, creating a saw-tooth silhouette that is particularly prominent on the inner margins of both lobes.
